sources.title: up-computer: README.md
sources.locator: Install, What it does, repository layout and license
sources.finding: Free desktop workspace for existing coding agents and own subscriptions; local tasks/workers/bots and optional remote access. Up.computer mobile and relay source inherited from upstream are not established shipped product clients.

sources.title: up-computer: LICENSE
sources.locator: Whole MIT license
sources.finding: MIT source with T3 Tools and Kirill Gurianov copyright; third-party bundled components and brand rights remain separate.

sources.title: up-computer: apps/desktop/package.json
sources.locator: main, electron dependency and productName
sources.finding: Electron desktop shell, with productName labelled Alpha at this pin. This is not fully native platform UI.

sources.title: up-computer: docs/user/install.md
sources.locator: Desktop app, up command, mobile app and providers
sources.finding: macOS, Windows and Linux desktop; bundled up CLI; browser/server use. Up.computer has no own mobile app yet.

sources.title: up-computer: docs/user/remote-access.md
sources.locator: Remote host routes, pairing and Connect
sources.finding: Clients can reach an existing user-controlled runtime over Connect, direct network or SSH. Remote access does not supply vendor agent compute.

sources.title: up-computer: docs/user/background-service.md
sources.locator: Service installation and platform support
sources.finding: Background runtime is on the selected host. Linux systemd lingering differs from macOS login and Windows sign-in lifetime.

sources.title: up-computer: docs/user/tasks.md
sources.locator: Lines 1-105, task creation, statuses, projects and archive
sources.finding: Native local tasks have title, description, status, tags and project, and can be created manually or through chat.

sources.title: up-computer: docs/user/workers.md
sources.locator: Worker matching, fan-out, runs and messages
sources.finding: Product workers match task status/tags, create separate run chats, retain results and accept follow-up messages. Default one-at-a-time behavior is instruction-based; fan-out can be requested.

sources.title: up-computer: docs/user/automations.md
sources.locator: Task templates, schedules, human enablement and scheduled prompts
sources.finding: Automations create tasks and are disabled until a human enables them. Scheduled prompts and worker triggers are separate mechanisms.

sources.title: up-computer: docs/user/source-control.md
sources.finding: Product PR creation/review/linking and merge tools are distinct. Agent merge documentation promises last-read-commit binding; implementation call-path coverage remains a separate check.

sources.title: up-computer: docs/user/telemetry.md
sources.locator: Product usage, Turn it off, Surveys, Send feedback and diagnostics
sources.finding: Product analytics go to PostHog; optional relay traces have a separate data scope. Persistent Settings > About switch stops ordinary events/traces. User-chosen feedback/survey sends are exceptions, not silent ordinary collection.

sources.title: up-computer: docs/user/permission-modes.md
sources.locator: Provider/runtime permission modes
sources.finding: Provider permission and sandbox modes have different semantics and do not establish universal hostile-code containment.

sources.title: up-computer: apps/server/src/provider/builtInDrivers.ts
sources.locator: BUILT_IN_DRIVERS array
sources.finding: Registry installs Codex, Claude, Cursor, Grok, fx, OpenCode, Antigravity, Kiro, Pi, Muse and ACP Registry drivers.

sources.title: up-computer: apps/server/src/mcp/OrchestratorMcpService.ts
sources.finding: App-owned delegation requires an eligible live caller and enabled tools, chooses a provider target and can request a worktree strategy before preparing a child run. Read/await/cancel and retained child state are product services.

sources.title: up-computer: apps/server/src/telemetry/AnalyticsService.ts
sources.finding: PostHog defaults enabled. Policy, environment and persistent user opt-out gate ordinary sends. Desktop shell environment discovery temporarily holds export. Opt-out clears pending/failed ordinary event buffers. sendNow permits explicit user submissions separately.

sources.title: up-computer: apps/server/src/telemetry/TelemetryOptOut.ts
sources.locator: Whole file, telemetry-opt-out marker, load and save
sources.finding: Persistent opt-out marker survives updates; no marker means no user opt-out. This is separate from policy/environment controls.

sources.title: up-computer: apps/server/src/scheduling/Scheduler.ts
sources.locator: Scheduler runtime
sources.finding: Pinned host-side scheduler implementation. Automation and task-worker subsystems are not collapsed into this single module.

sources.title: up-computer: packages/source-control-github/src/server/GitHubPullRequestApi.ts
sources.locator: Lines 2823-2897, merge mutation and expectedHeadSha
sources.finding: Native GitHub merge API forwards an expected head when supplied. It is optional at this level; this does not prove a universal exact-revision gate for all human and agent call sites.
